data_source: USDA NRCS SNOTEL network (Utah sites). KSL page is server-rendered: React shell + tables embedded in HTML; only client API call is news-api.ksl.com/v1/weather/getHeaderWeather (header widget, not basin data).
columns_note: SWE in inches. Precip = water year (Oct 1 - Sep 30) in inches. % Avg = percent of long-term average. -M = missing data. * = data may not provide valid measure of conditions.
